info.title: Avaza API Documentation
info.description: Avaza is a work management platform for project management, resource scheduling, timesheets, expenses and invoicing. This API manages the projects, tasks, timesheets, expenses, invoices, bills and contacts of an Avaza account, authenticated with OAuth 2.0 or a Personal Access Token.

get.summary: Retrieves configuration details for the authenticated Avaza account, including timesheet settings, currency, branding, and feature flags.

200.description: Returns the account configuration details.

parameters.name: pageNumber

delete.summary: Deletes an estimate by its Estimate ID.
delete.description:
Only estimates with a status of Draft, Sent, Accepted or Rejected can be deleted.
Estimates that have been converted to an invoice are protected and
return 422. The estimate's line items and activity records are removed with it; file attachments
are flagged for asynchronous removal from storage. A repeat DELETE of the same ID returns 404,
so automation retry loops are safe.
            
Example request:  DELETE /api/Estimate?EstimateID=4120
Example response (200):  { "estimateID": 4120, "isDeleted": true }

parameters.name: EstimateID
parameters.description: The ID of the estimate to delete, supplied in the query string.

parameters.name: SendWebhooks
parameters.description: If true, fires the estimate_deleted webhook to subscribed endpoints. Defaults to false.

200.description: The estimate was deleted successfully.

400.description: No valid EstimateID was supplied.

403.description: The authenticated user does not have permission to delete estimates.

404.description: No estimate with the given ID was found in the account.

422.description: Deletion is blocked because of the estimate's status (e.g. it has been converted to an invoice).

post.summary:
Uploads a single file via multipart/form-data. Send the file in a "file" form field.
Optional query parameters linkToEntityType + linkToEntityId inline-link the upload to a Task, Expense, Estimate, or Invoice in the same call.
When no link is supplied, the row is inserted as AttachmentType="Draft" and reaped by the cleanup job after 24 hours if never linked.

parameters.name: linkToEntityType
parameters.description: Optional. One of: "Task", "Expense", "Estimate", "Invoice". When supplied, linkToEntityId must also be supplied.

parameters.name: linkToEntityId
parameters.description: Optional. The target entity's primary key. Required when linkToEntityType is supplied.

200.description: Returns the uploaded file attachment details.

400.description: Bad request (missing file, oversize, malformed payload, unknown entity, or content that is not the PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, BMP, TIFF or PDF format the filename or content type declares).

403.description: Caller lacks the required scope or right.

507.description: Insufficient storage allowance on the account.

post.summary:
Uploads a single file as a base64-encoded JSON body. Designed for MCP clients and other JSON-only callers that can't easily build multipart/form-data requests.
When body.LinkTo is supplied (entityType in {Task, Expense, Estimate, Invoice}), the row is linked in the same transaction; otherwise it is inserted as AttachmentType="Draft" for later linking.

requestBody.description: Filename, Base64Data, optional ContentType, optional LinkTo.

200.description: Returns the uploaded file attachment details.

400.description: Bad request (missing/invalid base64, oversize, malformed payload, unknown entity, or content that is not the PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, BMP, TIFF or PDF format the filename or content type declares).

403.description: Caller lacks the required scope or right.

507.description: Insufficient storage allowance on the account.

post.summary:
Uploads a single file by giving the server a public https URL to fetch from. The server downloads the file (capped at 50 MB, SSRF-protected: blocks RFC1918, loopback, link-local, AWS metadata IPs, and IPv6 ULA).
When body.LinkTo is supplied (entityType in {Task, Expense, Estimate, Invoice}), the row is linked in the same transaction; otherwise it is inserted as AttachmentType="Draft" for later linking.

requestBody.description: SourceUrl, optional Filename, optional ContentType, optional LinkTo.

200.description: Returns the uploaded file attachment details.

400.description: Bad request (missing/invalid URL, oversize, blocked source URL, unknown entity, or fetched content that is not the PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, BMP, TIFF or PDF format the filename or content type declares).

403.description: Caller lacks the required scope or right.

507.description: Insufficient storage allowance on the account.

put.summary:
Step 2 of the signed-URL upload flow: PUT the file bytes as the raw request body to the URL returned by POST api/FileAttachment/Upload.
The signed token in the query string is the only credential (no Authorization header). It is bound to the issuing user, account,
filename, content type and size limit, and rejected after it expires. Content-Length is required. The token is spent by the first
PUT that passes the Content-Length check, whether or not that upload then succeeds, so any later PUT gets 409; a 401, 410, 411 or 413
rejection happens before the body is read and leaves the token usable until it expires.
The response is identical to the other upload routes: a Draft attachment, or a linked one when LinkTo was supplied at authorise time.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: The signed upload token from the authorised URL.

requestBody.description: The raw file bytes as the request body. Content-Length is required.

200.description: Returns the uploaded file attachment details.

400.description: Bad request (empty body, oversize, blocked extension, or a body that is not the PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, BMP, TIFF or PDF format the authorised filename or content type declares).

401.description: Token missing, malformed or not signed by this server.

403.description: The issuing user may no longer upload.

409.description: Token already spent by an earlier PUT that passed the size check.

410.description: Token expired: request a new upload URL.

411.description: Content-Length header required (chunked bodies are not accepted).

413.description: Body larger than the authorised size.

429.description: Too many upload attempts from this address.

507.description: Insufficient storage allowance on the account.

post.summary:
Step 1 of the signed-URL upload flow. Authorises one upload for the calling user and returns a single-use PUT URL that expires after
FileUploadTokenTtlMinutes (default 15). Send the file bytes as the raw request body of a PUT to that URL (e.g. curl -T file "url");
the PUT response is the same FileAttachmentUploadResult the other upload routes return.
Designed for MCP and agent clients that can run an HTTP request but must never pass file bytes through the model.
Rights and the optional LinkTo target are checked here, at issue time, and again when the PUT arrives.

requestBody.description: Filename, optional ContentType, optional SizeBytes (upper bound for the PUT), optional LinkTo.

200.description: Returns the upload URL, its expiry and the file metadata that will be applied.

400.description: Bad request (missing filename, blocked extension, size out of range, unknown entity).

403.description: Caller lacks the required scope or right.

503.description: Signed uploads are not configured on this server.

get.summary: Retrieves a paginated list of fixed-amount billing entries used for fixed-price project invoicing. Can filter by project, task, invoiced status, and updated date.

parameters.name: UpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Only return fixed amounts updated after this date-time.

parameters.name: ProjectID
parameters.description: (Optional) The ProjectID of a Project to filter Fixed Amounts for

parameters.name: TaskID
parameters.description: (Optional) The TaskID of a Task to filter Fixed Amounts for

parameters.name: isInvoiced
parameters.description: Filter by invoiced status: true for invoiced, false for uninvoiced.

parameters.name: CustomerID
parameters.description: (Optional) Only return fixed amounts whose project belongs to this customer company.

parameters.name: includeInvoiceDetails
parameters.description: When true, each linked fixed amount also returns the InvoiceIDFK of the invoice its line item belongs to.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of items per page (max 1000)

parameters.name: pageNumber
parameters.description: Page to display. Starts from 1.

parameters.name: Sort
parameters.description: Optional sorting instruction. Currently possible values: "DateUpdated", "DateCreated", "DateUpdated desc", "DateCreated desc"

200.description: Returns a paginated list of fixed-amount billing entries.

put.summary: Updates an existing fixed-amount billing entry. Only fields listed in the FieldsToUpdate array will be modified. Valid field names: Amount, InventoryItemIDFK, Notes.
put.description: Fixed amounts that have already been invoiced cannot be updated. Remove the linked invoice line first to release the record. TaskIDFK and ProjectIDFK cannot be changed — to move a fixed amount, delete it and create a new one.

requestBody.description: The request body containing the FixedAmountID, the field names to update and their new values.

200.description: Returns the updated fixed-amount entry.

post.summary: Creates a new fixed-amount billing entry against a task.
post.description: The project is always derived from the task, and the amount is in the currency of the customer the task's project belongs to. Fixed amounts cannot be added to tasks on internal or archived projects. The created record is immediately visible to GET /api/FixedAmount and invoiceable through the invoicing endpoints.

requestBody.description: The request body containing the new fixed amount details.

200.description: Returns the created fixed-amount entry.

parameters.name: pageSize

400.description: A required field is missing or a value is invalid (e.g. empty Name, negative price, value too long).

get.summary: Retrieves a single inventory/product item by its Inventory Item ID.

post.summary: Flags an existing Draft invoice as Sent ("Mark as Sent"). This is a status change only - the invoice is not emailed to the customer.
post.description: Only invoices currently in Draft status can be marked as Sent; any other status is rejected and nothing is changed. Zero-amount invoices are set to Paid rather than Sent. Use the SendWebhooks flag to fire the invoice_sent webhook event.

requestBody.description: The request body containing the InvoiceID, an optional DateSent, and an optional SendWebhooks flag.

400.description: Bad Request - missing InvoiceID, a DateSent in the future, or the invoice is not in Draft status.

403.description: Forbidden - caller lacks the roles required to manage invoices.

404.description: Not Found - no such invoice in this account.

200.description: Returns the invoice number, resulting status and the Date Sent that was recorded.

post.summary: Appends line items to an existing invoice WITHOUT modifying or deleting its other line items (unlike PUT /api/Invoice, which replaces the full line item collection). Each line item may optionally link uninvoiced timesheets, expenses or a fixed amount via TimesheetEntryIDs / ExpenseIDs / FixedAmountIDs; quantities, prices, descriptions and taxes are calculated from the linked records unless supplied, and the linked records are marked as invoiced. The request is atomic: if any line item or link is invalid, nothing is added. The invoice must not be Void; totals, balance and status are recalculated (e.g. a Paid invoice becomes Partial when its total grows).

requestBody.description: The invoice ID, the line items to append (with optional source-record links), optional expense exchange-rate overrides, and the SendWebhooks flag.

200.description: Returns the updated invoice, the new TransactionLineItemIDs, and any warnings.

400.description: A line item or source link failed validation. The response details every problem; nothing was changed.

404.description: No invoice with that ID exists.

409.description: A linked record was invoiced concurrently by another request; nothing was changed.

post.summary: Deletes specific line items from an invoice and releases any timesheets, expenses or fixed amounts linked to them back to uninvoiced. Unlike PUT /api/Invoice (which replaces the whole line item collection), this endpoint only touches the line items you name. The invoice must not be Void and must retain at least one line item; totals, balance and status are recalculated.

requestBody.description: The invoice ID, the TransactionLineItemIDs to delete, and the SendWebhooks flag.

200.description: Returns the updated invoice and the IDs of the released source records.

400.description: A line item ID does not belong to this invoice, the invoice is Void, or the removal is not allowed; nothing was changed.

404.description: No invoice with that ID exists.

post.summary: DRY RUN: computes the line items that AddUninvoicedItems would create for the given filters - quantities, blended rates, converted expense amounts with markup, generated descriptions, taxes, and the source record IDs each line covers - WITHOUT saving anything or marking any record as invoiced. Use it to answer "what is ready to bill onto this invoice?" and to confirm with a person before calling AddUninvoicedItems.

requestBody.description: The invoice ID and the Time / Expenses / FixedAmounts filter sections (at least one required). SendWebhooks is ignored.

200.description: Returns the computed line items and totals. An empty LineItems list means nothing is currently ready to bill for the filters.

Each ID must be owned by the current user and not already linked to another entity. Maximum 8 attachments per message; ResponseBody is capped at 16,000 characters.
            
To @mention a user — which notifies them and adds them as a follower of the task — embed a mention span in ResponseBody. The span MUST carry a class attribute immediately before data-mentionid, e.g.

The class attribute is required: a span with only data-mentionid (no class) is stored as plain text and is NOT parsed as a mention, so the user is neither notified nor followed. Resolve the numeric user id via GET /api/User. Repeat the span to mention multiple users.

Quantity is 1 and UnitPrice is calculated from the expense amounts (including category markup and currency conversion) unless overridden. A line item may link only ONE source type, and InventoryItemIDFK/InventoryItemName/ProjectIDFK must be omitted on linked lines.

FixedAmountIDs.description: Optional. ID of an uninvoiced Fixed Amount to link to this line item - maximum ONE per line item (fixed amounts are always invoiced on their own line). Quantity is 1 and UnitPrice/Tax/InventoryItem come from the fixed amount unless overridden. A line item may link only ONE source type, and InventoryItemIDFK/InventoryItemName/ProjectIDFK must be omitted on linked lines.
